rubrics.justification: It appropriately states that no image/Gardner score was provided and avoids fabricating morphology, but therefore does not deliver the requested morphological analysis.
It thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, sperm quality, endometrium, BMI, and prior cycle history into prognosis and transfer expectations.
The reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with probability ranges tied to embryo quality and patient factors, though some quantitative adjustments are somewhat heuristic.
Much of the advice is standard, but recommending ERA early after only one failed cycle and suggesting immunologic/NK testing are not strongly guideline-supported for this scenario.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer support and contingency planning, though some recommendations are more speculative than necessary for a young good-prognosis patient.
